title: 银行流水与凭证全量对账
context: 审计人员需要同时寻找银行端和账簿端的未匹配。
requirements: 2025年费用凭证（按reference_no）与银行支出绝对值（按reference_no）分别汇总；采用全量键集合；空银行参考号使用每笔流水独立键；输出存在缺失或差异的记录及差额（银行-账簿）。
commonError: 内连接无法找出缺失记录；NULL参考号不可合并成一笔。
mysqlSql: WITH a AS (SELECT reference_no ref,SUM(expense_cents) ledger FROM v_expenses WHERE entry_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY reference_no), b AS (SELECT COALESCE(reference_no,CONCAT('BANK-',bank_id)) ref,SUM(-amount_cents) bank FROM bank_transactions WHERE transaction_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY COALESCE(reference_no,CONCAT('BANK-',bank_id))), k AS (SELECT ref FROM a UNION SELECT ref FROM b) SELECT k.ref,a.ledger ledger_cents,b.bank bank_cents,COALESCE(b.bank,0)-COALESCE(a.ledger,0) difference_cents,CASE WHEN a.ref IS NULL THEN 'bank_only' WHEN b.ref IS NULL THEN 'ledger_only' ELSE 'difference' END issue FROM k LEFT JOIN a ON a.ref=k.ref LEFT JOIN b ON b.ref=k.ref WHERE a.ref IS NULL OR b.ref IS NULL OR a.ledger<>b.bank ORDER BY k.ref
